purpose: Historical proposal record for the Phase 2 four-state facility operational-status map. Candidate GREEN classifications were reviewed under the owner's strict evidence rule and were not promoted unless affirmative evidence supported the public state.
controlling_rules: Absence of a damage record alone is not sufficient for GREEN.
GREEN requires an affirmative untouched finding plus operational continuity; NO_REPORTED_DAMAGE_FOUND is insufficient by itself.
Presence, continued use of some functions, or absence of a shutdown report is not sufficient for BLUE.
YELLOW requires verified physical damage plus an explicitly destroyed or inoperable represented component; do not infer whole-base shutdown.
RED requires the represented tracked facility/node itself to be destroyed or not operating.
Administrative withdrawal, closure, transfer, or drawdown is not a combat-damage color state.

original_green_candidates.name: Incirlik Air Base
original_green_candidates.reason: Accepted evidence establishes operational continuity, but the damage predicate is only NO_REPORTED_DAMAGE_FOUND. The accepted March 13 event records a missile interception near Incirlik with intended target unresolved. The owner's GREEN standard forbids converting absence of verified damage into an affirmative untouched finding.

raf_akrotiri_disposition: NOT_PROMOTED. RAF Akrotiri is not a tracked facility record in data/facilities.json. The accepted reconciliation record describes the March 1 Akrotiri missile item as CONTESTED_NOT_PINNED with conflicting UK/Cyprus accounts, so the proposal's stronger damage assertion is not adopted.
handoff: Renderer must consume only the classified records in the accepted adjudication file and leave every unclassified facility neutral. No renderer inference is authorized.
